page.title: Hollow-core flush wood door product data

blocks.content: Door elevation diagram of a hollow-core flush wood door, showing a single rectangular face labeled “FLUSH FACE” and a small circular marker on the right.

Use: Interior, non-rated Nominal size: 24 in x 80 in Thickness: 1-3/8 in Core: Hollow honeycomb core Stiles and rails: Composite wood Faces: Birch veneer, flush Finish: Clear factory finish Warranty: One year limited
Factory-assembled flush wood door for non-rated interior openings. Supply with clear-finished birch veneer faces.
Store doors flat in a dry, ventilated interior space. Protect finished faces from dirt, moisture, direct sunlight, and construction damage.
Field verify each opening before fabrication. Install plumb and square with uniform clearances. Follow the approved hardware schedule.
